specification.rationale: Large throttle edits destabilized load-transfer transients. Preserve learned throttle modulation and compensate the single-track steady-state curvature loss from a small speed increase. Gain derived from vehicle equations, not fitted.

method: reasoned analytic edits; no training, fitting, gradient or automated search
observation: original single 1080-ray lidar; no velocity, slip, yaw rate or memory
